data.name: Redneck Deer Huntin'
data.detailed_description:
Every Day Is Opening Day!


From the creators of Redneck Rampage comes a hunting game that's so real, you'll be expectin' the Game Warden to be checkin' tags! But don't worry, this is All Season, All Weapons, All Thrillin' and Killin' with your helpful local backwoods guide, Leonard.

You'll explore acres and acres of prime habitat, inclduing forest, woodlands, lake, snow park and shooting range - using all your available trackin' skills to follow, find and finish off your prey. Use attractant scent and choose between rifle, shotgun, pistol or crossbow for varying levels of difficulty.

So lock'n'load and git ready for a little Redneck style huntin' fun!

Choice Of Prey

  • Deer
  • Turkey
  • Razorback
  • Duck

Fantastic Firepower

  • Rifle
  • Pistol
  • Shotgun
  • Crossbow

Realistic Perspective

  • Track your game by finding markings and droppings on the terrain
  • Walk the terrain; stalk your prey from the hunter's point of view, not overhead
  • Use attractant scent to find'em and flush'em

Approved By Real Rednecks

  • Starring Burton Gilliam as Leonard
  • Display your kill in the Redneck Trophy Room
  • Wear sleeveless camo t-shirts
  • Hunt, Hunt, Hunt!

When it comes to huntin' real good, who gets more action than a redneck?

data.short_description: Deer hunting, redneck style! Join Leonard, a redneck native, and do your hunting four different animals (deer, duck, razorback, and wild turkey) in 8 acres of wilderness with different weapons in Redneck country. This is hunting with attitude!

reviews.review:
Just to let everyone know, THE FIRE BUTTON DOES WORK.  You just need to PRESS F2 TO LOAD UP THE WEAPON (for the scoped rifle, press F2 to load the weapon and then F1 to aim down your sight -- then, without moving, fire the rifle).  Now, you can use your weapons!  Hope this helps... ;)

Still, it took a while to discover this.  This vital piece of info should have been displayed at the main menu or on the Steam Page itself.  Also, the config files for both DOSbox and the game had to be adjusted to run more smooth.  Here is my advice:

1)  Head to your Steam's game directory: C:\Steam\steamapps\common\Redneck Deer Huntin'

2)  Click the dosboxRR config file to open it.

3)  Change it to these settings:
      • fullscreen=true
      • fulldouble=true
      • fullresolution=0.0
      • windowresolution=0.0
      • output=openglnb
      • memsize=64
      • aspect=true

4)  Save the changes by holding Ctrl+S, then close out of it

5)  Head into the HUNTIN' folder and select the HUNTIN' config file

6) Change the settings to this:
      • ScreenMode = 1
      • ScreenWidth = 640
      • ScreenHeight = 480

      (the next is optional, if you want to move with the WASD keys and have other controls set easier)
